patthana16.51:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nahetu nasahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.51:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nahetu naahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
